duration.text: The Business Administration at Tongji University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 21388 USD/per year ￥ 154000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. My ordinary passport personal information page (passport valid until January 30, 2026 and beyond) 2. Bachelor's degree certificate and degree diploma. For certificates in languages other than Chinese or English, the original notarized translation in Chinese or English must be provided. The notarization must be issued by the Chinese embassy or consulate in the foreign country or the foreign embassy or consulate in China. For fresh graduates, the original expected graduation certificate should be issued by their respective schools. If admitted, they are required to bring the original graduation certificate to verify upon registration. 3. Original copies or notarized versions of all course transcripts from the undergraduate period. Original notarized copies of transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be provided, along with their Chinese or English translations. The notarization must be issued by the Chinese embassy or consulate in the foreign country or the foreign embassy or consulate in China. 4. Proof of language proficiency. The new TOEFL score must be no less than 80 points, or the IELTS score must be no less than 6.0, or there must be relevant proof that English was the language used for teaching or work in the previous stage of study. 5. Personal Statement. Please fill in according to "Personal Statement.docx". The written text should be in the language of the specific course (write in Chinese for Chinese-taught courses, and in English for English-taught courses). 6. Two recommendation letters. The original recommendation letters from two associate professors or scholars with equivalent qualifications or above (please include the contact information of the recommenders). 7. Physical examination form for foreigners (within six months) or the currently valid visa in China. 8. Payment proof for registration fee. For offline bank transfers or online banking transfers, you need to provide a photo of the remittance voucher or a screenshot of the online transfer. When making a transfer through the online application system, there is no need to submit any documents. After submitting the application, you can directly make the payment within the system. Those who have not paid the registration fee will not be reviewed. 9. Supplementary Materials. Other supplementary application materials. Such as the letter of approval from the foreign student's supervisor for guidance, award certificates, and other university admission notices, etc. 10. Supplementary Materials for Master's Students of the Design Creativity Institute (This supplementary application material is only required to be submitted by applicants for the relevant majors of the Design Creativity Institute. Applicants for other majors do not need to submit it.)

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health. 2. Those who are studying for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree. Scholarship recipients must be under the age of 35, while self-funded students must be under the age of 45.
